metadata.title: The Merry Mixer from the House of Schenley
metadata.source_file: 1938 The Merry Mixer from the House of Schenley.txt
metadata.notes: Folleto promocional publicado en 1938 por Schenley Distillers Corp. (Nueva York), uno de los grandes productores de whisky estadounidense tras el fin de la Ley Seca. Incluye una seleccion de cocteles clasicos americanos (Whiskey Sour, Manhattan, Mint Julep, Bronx, Martini, Aviation, White Lady, Clover Club, Singapore Sling, Old Fashioned, Mamie Taylor, Side Glance, Merry Widow, Yale, Dubonnet Manhattan), highballs, fizzes, slings y daisies, mas una serie tematica de 12 cocteles uno por cada mes del ano (January Resolution, February Railsplitter, March Shamrock, April Surprise, May Bud, June Jubilee, July Kraker, August Frosted Golden Wedding, September Sensation, October Discovery, November Gobbler, December Toddy). Cierra con la lista de productos Schenley distribuidos en la epoca. Saltadas (no son recetas reales): Mark of Merit (Slogan promocional Schenley, no es receta); Juice of Yz Lemon (Linea fragmentada de ingrediente (1/2 limon)); White of 1 Egg (Linea fragmentada de ingrediente (clara de huevo)); Slice Orange Peel (Linea fragmentada de ingrediente (cascara de naranja)); Triple Sec (Linea fragmentada de ingrediente (Triple Sec)); Dash of Orange Juice (Linea fragmentada de ingrediente); Juice of Lime (Linea fragmentada de ingrediente); Teaspoon of Grenadine (Linea fragmentada de ingrediente); Vi Italian Vermouth (Linea fragmentada (1/2 vermut italiano)); Juice of 4 Oranges (Linea fragmentada de ingrediente); White of 1 Egg (Linea fragmentada de ingrediente (clara de huevo)); A Royal Concoction for Festive Occasions— (Frase introductoria del coctel siguiente, no es receta); BOTTLED IN BOND UNDER U. S. GOVT. SUPERVISION (Banner promocional 'Bottled in Bond' (regulacion estadounidense de whiskies envejecidos en barrica federal), no es receta); Bourbon. (Encabezado de la lista de bourbons Schenley, no es receta); BLENDED STRAIGHT WHISKIES (Encabezado de la lista de blends de whisky Schenley, no es receta); RUM (Encabezado de la lista de rones distribuidos por Schenley, no es receta); FINE IMPORTED LIQUORS (Encabezado de la lista de licores importados por Schenley, no es receta); BARDINET LIQUEURS (Encabezado de la lista de licores Bardinet importados por Schenley, no es receta)

We wish you wealth and health;
We wish you gold in store.
We hope you'll have everything—
What friend could wish you more?

     Copyright, 1938
SCHENLEY PRODUCTS CO.
    New York, N. Y.

INTRODUCTION



The proper mixing of drinks has always been considered
   an art. The House of Schenley deems it not only a privi
lege, but an institutional duty to offer the suggestions con
tained in the Merry Mixer. It is the hope that this hook of
recipes will serve as a guide. Also as the bartender's reference,
to insure delectable and correctly mixed drinks that will satisfy
the imagination and taste of those who find enjoyment in par
taking of what a beneficent nature has provided for the pleas
ure of mankind.
  Schenley products are your guidance to high quality. They
are standards for integrity and excellence wherever sold or
dispensed.
  The recipes printed in the Merry Mixer include many made
famous in the past at such world-renowned New York bars as
the old and new Waldorf, the Ritz Carlton, the Old Knicker
bocker, Delmonico's, Sherry's and many other places of equal
prominence throughout the United States.
  Your good health, good drinks, and all the happiness the
world may provide you Sir! and Madam! is the toast The
House of Schenley gives to every reader and user of these
famous recipes.
                  SCHENLEY PRODUCTS CO.
             Empire State Building, New York, N. Y.

         Look for ihe
             Schenlo'y
